label: gym_kusa_010_receptionist_02
text: Let me register you as a challenger. Your name is\n[VAR 0x0100(0000)], yes?

label: gym_kusa_010_receptionist_03
text: Great! Now, in order to face Gym Leader\nBrassius, you’ll first need to pass the Gym Test.

label: gym_kusa_010_receptionist_04
text: Here at the Artazon Gym, that means completing\na game of [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]Sunflora Hide-and-Seek[VAR 0xFF00(0000)]!

label: gym_kusa_010_receptionist_history
text:
As you may know, Artazon is a city of artists.\c
The artwork made by the people here is largely
inspired by nature and the sun that nurtures it.\c
Since Sunflora embody these concepts, we try to
gather them and take good care of them!

label: gym_kusa_010_receptionist_05
text: Your job today is to find the Sunflora located\nthroughout Artazon. Remember—these Pokémon\r\nlook like sun-shaped flowers!

label: gym_kusa_010_receptionist_06
text: Gather up [VAR 0x0201(0001)] of them and bring them to the\nSunflora Lawn, and you pass the test.

label: gym_kusa_010_receptionist_map
text:
I’ll register the Sunflora Lawn’s location in your
map app to get you started.\c
When you leave the Gym, turn right and you’ll
see two large Sunflora statues—head for those!\c
Once you’re at the lawn’s entrance, the staffer
there will tell you more about the Gym Test.

label: gym_kusa_010_receptionist_07
text: Now get out there and have fun!
